title: badf-requirements authoring skill (salvage PR #47 onto the canonical G02 gate) — IMPLEMENTED
objective: Build badf-requirements as a top-level authoring skill (sibling of badf-prd) that decomposes an approved PRD baseline into the four canonical G02 artifacts (requirements, nfr, traceability, definition-of-ready) and validates them with `badf_gate.py dossier` -- never with a validator of its own. Salvage only the authoring layer from the superseded PR #47: the RTM decomposition model, the quantified-NFR discipline, the security-provenance rule, and the authority boundary 'author requirements, never approve G02'. business_value: The canonical G02 gate (WP-0041) enforces the four requirement artifacts, but nothing authors them -- there was no requirements-decomposition skill, only PR #47's superseded design that duplicated the gate. This gives BADF the missing authoring capability with a clean separation (skill authors, gate verifies, authority decides), preserves #47's genuine requirements-engineering work, and discards its obsolete governance implementation. Landing at IMPLEMENTED (not ACTIVE) keeps the admission ladder honest -- validation with real cases is a separate WP.
